columns.description: This is the Control Area name/Booth name and is the internal identification of a booth at a given station. For example: A002.
columns.name: C/A

columns.description: The remote unit ID of the station, which consists of a three-digit numeric designation preceded by ‘R’, such as R001.
columns.name: Unit

columns.description: This is the subunit/channel/position, or specific address, for a specific turnstile. For example, 01-00-01.
columns.name: SCP

columns.description: The name of the subway station.
columns.name: Station

columns.description: The train lines that stop at the station, such as 456. Train lines stopping at this location.
columns.name: Line Name

columns.description: The division of the subway system for the station (BRT, IRT, IND) or the system, if not part of the subway (PTH, JFK, SRT, RIT). Independent Subway System (IND).
columns.name: Division

columns.description: The date of the audit data (MM/DD/YYYY).
columns.name: Date

columns.description: The time of the reported data (HH:MM:SS).
columns.name: Time

columns.description: This is a description of the type of audit, which typically occurs every four hours (though they may occur more frequently due to planning or troubleshooting activities). The values are either REGULAR for a scheduled audit event, or RECOVR AUD, which refers to a missed audit that was recovered.
columns.name: Description

columns.description: The cumulative ENTRY register value for a turnstile. This is a 10-digit number that represents the number of entries on the turnstile since it was last initialized.
columns.name: Entries

columns.description: The cumulative EXIT register value for a turnstile. This is a 10-digit number that represents the number of exits on the turnstile since it was last initialized.
columns.name: Exits
